summary: Phase 3 backend-only testing. 35/35 tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_polish.py. Covered: new admin login (abhisheksharma@thermalcasting.com), removal of all three old staff accounts (all return 401 as required), customer signup still functional (backend intact, /auth/register requires full_name), /auth/me strips password_hash and session_id, session listing with current=true and user_agent/ip/last_seen/expires_at fields, 10-session cap with oldest revoked (reason session_limit) — verified 11-login flow revokes oldest, DELETE /auth/sessions/{sid} revokes the target and its token returns 401 with 'Session revoked or expired', logout-others returns revoked_count and revokes all except current, /auth/logout revokes current session. Change-password: 401 on wrong current, 400 on mismatch, 400 on same-as-current, 422 on <8 chars, success revokes other sessions (current retained), login with new pw works, audit-log records auth.password_change, password RESET back to original TCL@casting1234 so downstream tests keep working. Uploads: 401 without token, 403 with customer role, image/png upload returns {id,url,content_type,size} with url starting /api/files/, static mount at BASE_URL/api/files/<filename> serves the file (image/* content-type), DELETE /admin/upload/{id} removes file and subsequent static GET returns 404, text/plain rejected 400, empty file rejected 400. Regression: 40 products, 15 enabled materials (16 seeded, 1 disabled — see minor note), 10 categories, media/videos, guest RFQ (with correct schema company_name/contact_person/phone/project_details/items), AI chat with session_id all pass. RBAC: admin CAN create materials/categories/news/read company/read audit-logs; admin CANNOT create or delete staff (403 verified — enforced by require_super_admin).

minor.issue: Endpoint filters {enabled: True} and now returns 15 materials, but the seed inserted 16. One material has been toggled to enabled=false (likely leaked from a prior test iteration). Not a Phase 3 regression, but seed drift worth noting — consider re-seeding on next boot or reviewing tests that toggle materials.

No GET handler for /admin/materials (only POST/PATCH/DELETE). If admin UI needs to list disabled materials too, add a GET /admin/materials endpoint (currently only enabled ones are visible via public /materials).
Same as materials — no admin GET. Only /categories (public) exists.

Order of validation: same-as-current check (400) runs BEFORE verifying current_password (401). If a user submits the correct current_password reused as new_password, they get 400 even though credentials are valid — acceptable, but consider verifying current_password first for clearer error semantics.

action_items: Investigate why 1 material is disabled — either re-seed to enable=true or accept the drift. Consider making the seed idempotently re-enable core materials.
Optionally add GET /api/admin/materials and GET /api/admin/categories that return disabled items too (currently admin UI has to rely on the public filtered endpoint).

server.py is 1537 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Now overdue for refactor into routers (auth, sessions, upload, products, materials, categories, media, rfq, ai, admin_cms, staff, audit, csv).
Long-standing minor: replace count_documents()+1 ref_no generators with atomic counters (RFQ, inquiries, products, CSV import) — carried over from iteration 2.

conftest.py was updated to use the new primary admin. Older /backend/tests/test_thermal_casting_backend.py and test_phase2_cms.py still reference the deleted admin/superadmin/sales accounts in their own fixtures/test bodies and will fail if re-run — main agent should decide whether to archive them or port to the new single-admin model.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT now carries sid claim and get_current_user validates the session on every request (looks up db.sessions, checks revoked=False, updates last_seen). Correct implementation of revocable sessions.

_prune_and_create_session correctly (a) revokes expired sessions past absolute expiry, (b) while active >= 10, revokes the OLDEST by last_seen with reason=session_limit, then inserts the new one — verified via 11 logins test.
/auth/me correctly strips session_id from the returned dict (line 308-309) — verified.
change-password revokes {revoked:False, id: {$ne: current_sid}} — current session retained, others revoked with reason=password_change. Verified.

Upload endpoint enforces ALLOWED_MIME whitelist (image/pdf/video), 20MB cap, sha256 checksum, uuid filename, and audit-logs upload.create/upload.delete. Static files served at app-level /api/files (NOT under api router) — request bypasses JSON handlers as intended.
Delete upload correctly removes both the filesystem file (unlink) and the db.uploads row; subsequent static GET returns 404 (verified).

require_super_admin enforcement remains for /admin/staff — admin (not super_admin) correctly gets 403 on POST and DELETE staff. Since no super_admin exists in the seeded DB, staff CRUD is effectively locked (as intended by problem statement).
Seed function seeds only the primary admin if not exists (never overwrites) — behaviour matches spec.
server.py is 1537 lines — modularization is now urgent.

Old admin/superadmin/sales accounts have been DELETED and MUST return 401. Session-management endpoints under /api/auth/{sessions, sessions/{sid}, sessions/logout-others, logout, change-password}. IMPORTANT for future test runs: (1) pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope by default; the session-management tests must run serially because parallel workers logging in as the same admin trigger session_limit revocations across classes. Use `-n 0` when running only Phase 3, or keep session-heavy tests inside one loadscope (single class). (2) admin_token fixture is now function-scoped in conftest. (3) Old test files test_thermal_casting_backend.py and test_phase2_cms.py have fixtures/tests referencing deleted accounts (admin@thermalcasting.com etc.) — they will fail if run against the current DB.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. Only observation: /materials returns 15 not 16 because one material has enabled=false in the DB — data drift from previous iterations, not a Phase 3 regression. Recommend an idempotent re-enable step in the seed to guarantee 16 visible materials post-boot.
